name: PerpRegimeFee
mechanic: Sets the LP fee from a market regime posted by the operator's wallet, with a fixed operator skim on top of the universal AeonFee.
plain: A dynamic-fee v4 hook. The operator's wallet sets the market regime and beforeSwap overrides the LP fee to match (risk-on 0.10%, neutral 0.30%, risk-off 1.00%). On top of the universal 10 bps AeonFee, afterSwap takes a fixed 10 bps operator fee, on exact-in and exact-out.
rules: beforeSwap sets the LP fee from the oracle regime: risk-on 0.10%, neutral 0.30% (default), risk-off 1.00%.
The regime fee only applies to pools created with the dynamic-fee flag; a static-fee pool ignores the override but still pays the operator skim.
The regime is set off-chain by the operator's wallet via updateRegime (onlyOracle); the oracle address is immutable and is not an on-chain feed.
A fixed 10 bps operator fee is taken on top of the universal 10 bps AeonFee, both to immutable recipients, with no custody.

fee.note: Fixed 10 bps operator fee, on top of the universal 10 bps AeonFee and the dynamic regime LP fee.
